title: Sustainable Tourism
content: Tourism is a massive industry that brings money and jobs to many countries. However, mass tourism can also cause significant damage to the environment and local communities. This is why "sustainable tourism" is gaining popularity. Sustainable tourism means traveling in a way that minimizes negative impacts. For example, instead of staying in large international hotel chains, sustainable tourists might choose local guesthouses. They respect the local culture, try to reduce plastic waste, and avoid activities that harm wildlife. Cities like Venice and Barcelona are struggling with the number of tourists and are introducing rules to protect their heritage. By being a responsible traveler, you can help preserve beautiful destinations for future generations.
